title: Dyatlov Pass 😱 9 Log, Ek Kata Hua Tent | Ansuljhe Rahasya Ep 1
setting: northern Ural Mountains, Soviet Russia, winter 1959; the mountain scenes are remote wilderness with no buildings
characters: the hikers are young Soviet students in 1959 winter hiking gear: thick knitted wool sweaters, padded canvas anoraks, fur-lined hats, wooden skis, heavy canvas backpacks
description:
1959 ki ek raat, Russia ke barfeele pahadon par 9 tajurbekaar hikers ne apna tent andar se kaata aur nange paon andhere mein bhaag gaye. Koi zinda nahi lauta.
Yeti, secret test, orange golay ya avalanche? Asli tathya aur nayi research ke saath.

#dyatlovpass #unsolvedmystery #AnsuljheRahasya
